thread:
olivia-finance: Heads up 10: we got an AP dispute from BetaTech. They say the private deployment invoice double-billed the platform license and the dedicated capacity fee for Apr.

rachel-sales: Wait what? They have a dedicated reserved pool + private on-prem package. Sales notes say platform license only once per account, not per deployment.

emma-customer-success: BetaTech sent the payment hold: 'we were charged Platform Annual $60k and Dedicated Pool Apr $12k; PO shows only Dedicated monthly, platform was prepaid Q1'. They're asking for an itemized breakdown.

kevin-ops: Checking billing logs. I see two product lines applied on 2025-04-01: product=platform_annual price=60000 quantity=1 and product=dedicated_pool_monthly price=12000 quantity=1. The contract import had both items enabled.

billing-bot: Billing job 2025-04-01T02:05:12Z processed invoice BT-2025-04-015. Applied items: platform_annual(prorate_flag=true, start=2025-04-01), dedicated_pool_monthly. Contract_ref=CT-887.

olivia-finance: The core issue: sales SOW for BetaTech (CT-887) had platform prepaid in Jan (invoice BT-2025-01-002) for the year. The contract import should have set product=platform_annual to 0 for subsequent months. Looks like the renewal ingestion didn't mark it as already-paid.

rachel-sales: Confirmed: SOW shows platform paid upfront. We also added Dedicated pool later in March and that should be invoiced monthly. No additional platform charge.

kevin-ops: Options: 1) issue credit memo for the platform line and update invoice (fast) 2) refund payment and reissue (slow) 3) create account-level credit to be consumed next invoice. Which do we want?

tom-legal: Prefer credit memo + corrected invoice with a note referencing original platform invoice BT-2025-01-002. Keeps audit trail tidy. Also need a sign-off from Sales leadership.

olivia-finance: Calculate amounts 10: platform annual $60,000 (already paid). Deduct $60,000 from this invoice and keep dedicated $12,000. If they've already paid, issue CM-BT-015-1 for $60,000.

emma-customer-success: I'll notify Jane (billing@betatech.com) and tell them we're issuing a credit and will resend updated invoice. She asked to keep net-30 terms.

billing-bot: Action: created credit_memo=CM-BT-015-1 amount=60000 applied_to_invoice=BT-2025-04-015 note='duplicate platform charge; prepaid invoice BT-2025-01-002'.

olivia-finance: Approve the plan. Please also attach the paid platform invoice snapshot to the corrected invoice metadata.

rachel-sales: I approve. Posting the SOW excerpt and payment receipt in the thread for records.

kevin-ops: Done. Updated the billing ingestion rules: if contract_id has platform_paid=true then skip platform_annual on recurring invoices. Pushed a quick fix to billing-config repo. Ticket: billing/config#402.

billing-bot: Job log updated. Next invoice generation will skip platform_annual for account BetaTech.

olivia-finance: Closing loop: we'll send corrected invoice BT-2025-04-015-R1 and CM-BT-015-1 to BetaTech AP and set invoice status to due for $12,000. Emma to confirm receipt.

emma-customer-success: I'll confirm once AP acknowledges. :thumbsup:

tom-legal: Also adding a note to the renewal playbook to verify 'platform_paid' flag on contract ingestion.

olivia-finance: Thanks everyone. Rolling to postmortem with billing/config#402 owners to prevent recurrence.
